nodes.label: Your agent app
nodes.desc: Any LLM agent loop: after each turn it calls memory.add(messages, user_id=...) and before each turn memory.search(query, filters={...}).

nodes.label: Memory.add()
nodes.desc: add() normalizes messages into entity-scoped filters (user_id/agent_id/run_id) and delegates to _add_to_vector_store; infer=False stores raw text, infer=True (default) runs the extraction flow.

nodes.label: get / update / delete / history
nodes.desc: The maintenance surface: get/get_all read payloads, update re-embeds and rewrites a vector, delete removes it, history() replays the audit trail, reset() drops everything.

nodes.label: Memory.search()
nodes.desc: search() validates top_k/threshold and mandatory filters, then hands off to _search_vector_store for hybrid scoring and optionally to a reranker.

nodes.label: _add_to_vector_store (V3 batch flow)
nodes.desc: Eight phases: gather recent context, retrieve similar existing memories, one LLM extraction call, batch embed, MD5 hash dedup, batch persist, entity linking, save messages.

nodes.label: Extraction LLM
nodes.desc: generate_response() is called once per add() with ADDITIVE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT and response_format json_object to turn the conversation into candidate fact records.

nodes.label: Entity store linking
nodes.desc: extract_entities_batch() finds entities in each fact; they are embedded, deduped against the entity collection (exact or >=0.95 similarity) and linked via linked_memory_ids.

nodes.label: Embedder (embed / embed_batch)
nodes.desc: OpenAIEmbedding.embed() embeds one text; embed_batch() chunks 100 inputs per call and is used for facts and entities in one shot.

nodes.label: Vector store (Qdrant, Chroma, FAISS...)
nodes.desc: VectorStoreFactory instantiates one of ~26 backends behind VectorStoreBase; Qdrant adds dense query_points search plus BM25 sparse keyword_search.

nodes.label: SQLiteManager (history + messages)
nodes.desc: Local SQLite at config.history_db_path: history table records every ADD/UPDATE/DELETE, messages table caches the last 10 turns per session scope for extraction context.

nodes.label: _search_vector_store (hybrid)
nodes.desc: Over-fetches 4x the limit, runs semantic + BM25 keyword search, extracts query entities for boosts, then scores candidates additively.

nodes.label: score_and_rank + reranker
nodes.desc: score_and_rank() combines semantic + normalized BM25 + entity boost over an adaptive max_possible; an optional reranker can reorder the survivors.
